00113 void PartBuffer::partitionImpulse(Buffer const& original)
00114 {
00115   for(int i = 0; i < original.getNumChannels(); i++)
00116   {
00117     partitionImpulseChannel(original, i);

00120 
00121 void PartBuffer::partitionImpulseChannel(Buffer const& original, const int channel)
00122 {
00123   const float *bufferSamples;
00124   long impulseLength;
00125 
00126   bufferSamples = original.getData(channel);
00127   
00128   impulseLength = original.size();
00129     
00130   long fftSize = fftEngine.size();
00131   long fftSizeHalved = fftSize / 2;
00132     
00133   long startPoint = this->startPoint;
00134   long endPoint = this->endPoint;
00135   long length = this->length;
00136   long numSamples;
00137   
00138   if (length && length < impulseLength)
00139     impulseLength = length; 
00140   if (endPoint && endPoint < impulseLength)
00141     impulseLength = endPoint;
00142   impulseLength -= startPoint;
00143   if (impulseLength < 0) impulseLength = 0;
00144   
00145   int numPartitions = impulseLength / fftSizeHalved;
00146   if (impulseLength % fftSizeHalved) numPartitions++;
00147   
00148   if (numPartitions * fftSizeHalved > this->bufferSize) 
00149     numPartitions = this->bufferSize / fftSizeHalved;
00150   
00151   float *bufferTemp1 = partTempBuffer.getData();
00152   float *impulseReal = getDataReal(channel);
00153   float *impulseImag = getDataImag(channel);
00154     
00155   DSPSplitComplex bufferTemp2;
00156   
00157   for (int i = 0; i < numPartitions; i++)
00158   {
00159     int bufferPos = i * fftSizeHalved;
00160     bufferTemp2.realp = impulseReal + (bufferPos);
00161     bufferTemp2.imagp = impulseImag + (bufferPos);
00162     
00163     // For proper ampwarping etc. - get two partitions - take FFTs of both - clip - ifft and overlap with hannging window
00164     
00165     if (impulseLength >= (bufferPos + fftSizeHalved)) numSamples = fftSizeHalved;
00166     else numSamples = impulseLength - bufferPos;
00167     
00168 #ifdef UGEN_VDSP
00169     memcpy(bufferTemp1, bufferSamples + startPoint + bufferPos, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00170     vDSP_vclr(bufferTemp1+numSamples, 1, partTempBuffer.size()-numSamples);
00171 #else
00172     // copy real time domain samples to Buffer_Temp1
00173     memcpy(bufferTemp1, bufferSamples + startPoint + bufferPos, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00174     
00175     // zero pad the rest of Buffer_Temp1
00176     for (int j = numSamples; j < partTempBuffer.size(); j++)
00177       bufferTemp1[j] = 0;
00178 #endif
00179     
00180     // Do FFT Straight Into Position...
00181     fftEngine.getInternal()->fft(bufferTemp2, bufferTemp1);
00182   }
00183     
00184   this->numPartitions = numPartitions;
00185 }

00192   fftSizeOver4(fftSize >> 2),

00194   bufferSize(partImpulse.getBufferSize()),
00195   resetAll(1),
00196   fftEngine(partImpulse.getFFTEngine()),
00197   scaleMultD(1.0 / (double) (fftSize)),// * 4)),  // trying without * 4 not sure the level output is right... yes without the *4 seems correct? not checked with fftw though (FFTReal and vDSP checked I think)
00198   scaleMult(vecSplat((float) (scaleMultD))),
00199   inputBuffer(BufferSpec((int)(bufferSize * 2), 1, false)),
00200   inputBufferSamples(inputBuffer.getData()),
00201   fftBuffersMemory(BufferSpec(fftSize * 4, 1, false)),

00238 void PartConvolveUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00239 {
00240   const int numSamples = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00241     
00242     vFloat *outputSamples = (vFloat*)uGenOutput.getSampleData();    
00243   vFloat *inputSamples = (vFloat*)inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00244       
00245   DSPSplitComplex impulseTemp, bufferTemp;
00246   DSPSplitComplex impulse;
00247     
00248   impulse.realp = partImpulse_.getDataReal(channel);
00249   impulse.imagp = partImpulse_.getDataImag(channel);
00250   
00251   LOCAL_DECLARE(float* const, fftTempBufferSamples);
00252   LOCAL_DECLARE(float* const, inputBufferSamples);
00253   
00254   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, tillNextFFT);
00255   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, rwPointer1);
00256   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, rwPointer2);
00257   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, fftOffset);
00258     
00259   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSize);
00260   const int fftSizeHalved = fftSize >> 1 ;
00261   const int fftSizeHalvedOver4 = fftSizeHalved >> 2;
00262   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeLog2);
00263   const int fftSizeHalvedLog2 = fftSizeLog2-1;
00264   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, bufferSize);
00265   
00266 #ifndef UGEN_VDSP
00267   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeOver4);
00268 #endif
00269   
00270   DSPSplitComplex fftTemp;
00271   fftTemp.realp = fftTempBufferSamples;
00272   fftTemp.imagp = fftTemp.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00273   
00274   const int Partitions = partImpulse_.getNumPartitions();
00275   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufPosition);
00276   
00277   // Schedule Stuff
00278   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, partitionsDone);
00279   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, scheduleCounter);
00280   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, lastPart);
00281   LOCAL_DECLARE(int, validPart);
00282   
00283   // FFT Stuff    
00284   LOCAL_DECLARE(vFloat **, fftBuffers);
00285   vFloat *tempvPointer1, *tempvPointer2;
00286   
00287   int numVectorsRemaining = numSamples >> 2;
00288   
00289   LOCAL_DECLARE(vFloat, scaleMult);
00290   vFloat zero = {0.,0.,0.,0.};
00291   
00292   if (resetAll) {
00293     // FFT Related
00294     int N = 1 << (fftSizeLog2 - 3);
00295     int randomStart;
00296     while (N <= (randomStart = std::rand() / (RAND_MAX / N))); // perhaps use Ran088 here?
00297     
00298     tillNextFFT = randomStart;
00299     rwPointer1 = (fftSizeHalved >> 2) - tillNextFFT;
00300     rwPointer2 = rwPointer1 + tillNextFFT;
00301     fftOffset = 0;
00302 
00303 #ifdef UGEN_VDSP
00304     vDSP_vclr(fftTempBufferSamples, 1, fftSize);
00305     vDSP_vclr(fftBuffersMemorySamples, 1, fftSize<<2);
00306 #else
00307     tempvPointer1 = (vFloat*)fftTempBufferSamples;
00308     for (int i = 0; i < fftSizeOver4; i++)  tempvPointer1[i] = zero;
00309     
00310     tempvPointer1 = (vFloat*)fftBuffersMemorySamples;
00311     for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++)   tempvPointer1[i] = zero;
00312 #endif      
00313     // Scheduling Related
00314     bufPosition = 0;
00315     scheduleCounter = 0;
00316     partitionsDone = 0;
00317     lastPart = 0;
00318     
00319     // How Many Partitions To Do...
00320     validPart = 1;
00321     
00322     this->resetAll = 0;
00323   }
00324   
00325   while (numVectorsRemaining > 0) {
00326     // Check whether there will be another FFT this vector
00327     int loop;
00328     int fftTest = numVectorsRemaining - tillNextFFT;
00329     if (fftTest > 0) {
00330       loop = tillNextFFT;
00331       numVectorsRemaining -= tillNextFFT;
00332       tillNextFFT = 0;
00333     } else {
00334       loop = numVectorsRemaining;
00335       tillNextFFT -= numVectorsRemaining;
00336       numVectorsRemaining = 0;
00337     }
00338     
00339     // Load input into buffer (twice) and output from the output buffer
00340     // Put it straight into the right place - using overlap save it would seem....
00341         
00342 #if 1 // let's try this...
00343     const int loopX4 = loop<<2;
00344     memcpy(fftBuffers[0] + rwPointer1, inputSamples, loopX4*sizeof(float));
00345     memcpy(fftBuffers[1] + rwPointer2, inputSamples, loopX4*sizeof(float));
00346     memcpy(outputSamples, fftBuffers[3] + rwPointer1, loopX4*sizeof(float));
00347     rwPointer1 += loop;
00348     rwPointer2 += loop;
00349     inputSamples += loop;
00350     outputSamples += loop;    
00351 #else
00352     for (int i = 0; i < loop; i++)
00353     {
00354       *(fftBuffers[0] + rwPointer1) = *inputSamples; 
00355       *(fftBuffers[1] + rwPointer2) = *inputSamples;
00356       
00357       *outputSamples++ = *(fftBuffers[3] + rwPointer1); 
00358       
00359       rwPointer1++;
00360       rwPointer2++;
00361       inputSamples++;
00362     }
00363 #endif
00364     
00365     // Work Loop
00366     
00367     if (partitionsDone >= validPart - 1) loop = 0;    // Check To See If there's more processing scheduled
00368     else loop = 1;
00369     scheduleCounter++;
00370     
00371     while (loop)
00372     {
00373       // How Many Partitions To Do....
00374       int numPartitionsToDo = (int)((float) ((scheduleCounter * (validPart - 1)) / (float) ((fftSizeHalved / numSamples) - 1)) - partitionsDone);
00375       if (scheduleCounter >= (fftSizeHalved / numSamples) - 1) 
00376         numPartitionsToDo = (validPart - partitionsDone) - 1;
00377       
00378       // Calculate Buffer Wraparound
00379       int nextPart = lastPart;
00380       if (nextPart >= Partitions) nextPart = 0;     // Flip Round Buffer Immediately
00381       lastPart = nextPart + numPartitionsToDo;
00382       if (lastPart > Partitions) {            // Flip Round In Middle
00383         lastPart = Partitions;
00384         numPartitionsToDo = lastPart - nextPart;
00385       }
00386       else loop = 0;                    // No Flip To Do
00387       
00388       // Do Processing
00389       int offset = (partitionsDone + 1) << fftSizeHalvedLog2;
00390       impulseTemp.realp = impulse.realp + offset;
00391       impulseTemp.imagp = impulse.imagp + offset;
00392       offset = nextPart << fftSizeHalvedLog2;
00393       bufferTemp.realp = inputBufferSamples + offset;
00394       bufferTemp.imagp = bufferTemp.realp + bufferSize;
00395       
00396       partitionsDone += numPartitionsToDo;
00397       
00398       for (int i = 0; i < numPartitionsToDo; i++) { 
00399         MultAndAdd(bufferTemp, impulseTemp, fftTemp, fftSizeHalvedOver4);
00400         impulseTemp.realp += fftSizeHalved;
00401         impulseTemp.imagp += fftSizeHalved;
00402         bufferTemp.realp += fftSizeHalved;
00403         bufferTemp.imagp += fftSizeHalved;
00404       }
00405     }
00406     
00407     // Check that there is a new FFTs worth of buffer 
00408     
00409     if (tillNextFFT == 0)
00410     {     
00411       if (++validPart > Partitions) validPart = Partitions;
00412       
00413       // Calculate the position to put the FFT output into
00414       impulseTemp = impulse;
00415       const int offset = bufPosition << fftSizeHalvedLog2;
00416       bufferTemp.realp = inputBufferSamples + offset;
00417       bufferTemp.imagp = bufferTemp.realp + bufferSize;
00418       
00419       // Do the FFT, Process and Convert back with scaling
00420       tempvPointer1 = fftBuffers[fftOffset];
00421       fftEngine.getInternal()->fft(bufferTemp, (float*)tempvPointer1);
00422             
00423       // Process First Partition Here (we need it now!)
00424       
00425       MultAndAdd(bufferTemp, impulseTemp, fftTemp, fftSizeHalvedOver4);
00426       
00427       if (--bufPosition < 0)
00428         bufPosition = Partitions - 1;
00429       
00430       // Processing Done - Do Inverse FFT
00431       fftEngine.getInternal()->ifft((float*)fftBuffers[2], fftTemp);
00432             
00433       // Overlap Save the Result
00434       loop = fftSize >> 3;
00435       int test = fftOffset;
00436       
00437       tempvPointer1 = fftBuffers[3] + (loop * (1 - test));
00438       tempvPointer2 = fftBuffers[3] + (loop * test);
00439       
00440       // post ifft scaling required by vDSP fft processes
00441       
00442 #ifdef UGEN_VDSP
00443       vDSP_vsmsa((float*)fftBuffers[2], 1, (float*)&scaleMult, (float*)&zero, (float*)tempvPointer1, 1, loop<<2);
00444       vDSP_vsma((float*)(fftBuffers[2]+loop), 1, (float*)&scaleMult, (float*)tempvPointer2, 1, (float*)tempvPointer2, 1, loop<<2);
00445 #else
00446       for (int i = 0; i < loop; i++)
00447         *(tempvPointer1++) = VEC_MUL_OP(*(fftBuffers[2] + i), scaleMult ZEROARG);
00448 
00449       for (int i = loop; i < fftSize >> 2; i++) {
00450         *(tempvPointer2) = VEC_ADD_OP(*(tempvPointer2), VEC_MUL_OP(*(fftBuffers[2] + i), scaleMult ZEROARG)); 
00451         tempvPointer2++;
00452       }     
00453 #endif    
00454 
00455       // Clear Buffer
00456 #ifdef UGEN_VDSP
00457       vDSP_vclr(fftTemp.realp, 1, fftSizeHalved);
00458       vDSP_vclr(fftTemp.imagp, 1, fftSizeHalved);
00459 #else
00460       for (int i = 0; i < fftSizeHalved; i++) fftTemp.realp[i] = 0.f;
00461       for (int i = 0; i < fftSizeHalved; i++) fftTemp.imagp[i] = 0.f;
00462 #endif          
00463       // Set wait till next data to hop time
00464       tillNextFFT = loop;
00465       
00466       // Reset RW_Pointers
00467       if (fftOffset) rwPointer1 = 0;
00468       else rwPointer2 = 0;
00469       fftOffset = 1 - fftOffset; // swaps between 0 and 1
00470       
00471       // Reset Schedule Stuff
00472       lastPart = bufPosition + 1;
00473       scheduleCounter = 0;
00474       partitionsDone = 0;
00475     }
00476   }
00477   
00478   LOCAL_COPY(bufPosition);
00479   LOCAL_COPY(fftOffset);
00480   LOCAL_COPY(tillNextFFT);
00481   LOCAL_COPY(rwPointer1);
00482   LOCAL_COPY(rwPointer2);
00483   
00484   LOCAL_COPY(partitionsDone);
00485   LOCAL_COPY(scheduleCounter);
00486   LOCAL_COPY(lastPart);
00487   LOCAL_COPY(validPart);
00488 }

00570 void TimeConvolveUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00571 {
00572   float *inputSamples = (float *)inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00573   float *outputSamples = (float *)uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00574   int numSamples = (int)uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00575   
00576   float *filter = filters.getData(channel);
00577   float *inputBufferSamples = ioBuffers.getData(TimeConvolveUGenInternal::InputBuffer);
00578   long position = this->position;
00579   long filterlength = filters.size();
00580   
00581   // N.B. Size of input_buf is always multiple of vectsize
00582   // We must be able to read out input in one go 
00583   // Copy input twice
00584   
00585   memcpy(inputBufferSamples + position, inputSamples, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00586   memcpy(inputBufferSamples + 4096 + position, inputSamples, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00587   
00588   position += numSamples;
00589   if (position >= 4096) position = 0;
00590   
00591   // Convolve Here
00592   
00593   vDSP_conv (inputBufferSamples + 4096 + position - (filterlength + numSamples) + 1, 1, 
00594          filter, 1, 
00595          outputSamples, 1, 
00596          numSamples, filterlength);
00597   
00598   this->position = position;  
00599 }
